title: Resolution Evidence Backlog
dataSources: Forecasts (`forecast:personal`), journal reviews (`forecast:journal`), resolved outcomes (`forecast:resolution`), calibration scores (`forecast:calibration`), ops reviews (`forecast:ops`).
app: Personal forecasting telemetry — Metaculus personal predictions, private prediction-journal entries, and calibration-bin scoring — streamed to Splunk HEC via exports and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=forecast:resolution source_name=* evidence_attached=*
| stats sum(eval(if(evidence_attached="no",1,0))) as backlog, count as total by source_name
| where backlog>0
| sort - backlog
description: Lists pending unattached evidence items backlog by evidence source for forecast resolution proofing.
value: Backlog counts expose where small unfinished tasks accumulate and create hidden drag inside forecast resolution proofing.
implementation: Mark each `forecast:resolution` record with a pending-state flag and summarize backlog totals by `source_name`.
visualization: Table of evidence source with pending unattached evidence items counts.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals where unfinished unattached evidence items are piling up so you can clear the biggest queues in forecast resolution proofing.
